node.title: Need a regex to replace incomplete html entities
node.author: Chris Daniel
node.doctext:
Hi Guys,

Just need a help in regex. I have xml file, but unfortunately some of xml tags consists of incomplete html entities. I was looking for a regex that would remove the incomplete html entities.

For eg: 1 SW PLT SLAC 6 PCS 

In above example,  is incomplete html entity of &; So I need to remove such incomplete data.

Expected output: 1 SW PLT SLAC 6 PCS I have tried to apply the sed command, but it removes when the pattern is matched.

I basically want to replace the string &,&#,,& to blank, but it should not replace &

Please help me.
